name: io.github.ni-c/osm-mcp
title: OpenStreetMap
description: Geocoding, walking/driving/cycling distances, route optimization, isochrones and POI search on OSM

environmentVariables.name: OSM_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Identifying User-Agent sent to all OSM services (Nominatim requires one)

environmentVariables.name: ORS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenRouteService key; switches routing/matrix/isochrones to ORS

environmentVariables.name: OSM_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

environmentVariables.name: OSM_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever OSM_ALLOW_TOOLS left
